findings.note: ESPN's game log has Malkin at 5 goals and 2 assists in 9 games this season. He has no assists or power-play assists in his last five games, and he played only 12:51 in the 6-2 loss at Vegas on Oct 17.
NHL.com's projected lineup for Oct 17 puts Malkin on the second line with Egor Chinakhov and Tommy Novak, behind Rakell-Crosby-Rust, at center on the right. He is not listed as injured.

Pittsburgh re-signed the now-40-year-old Malkin to a one-year, $5.5M deal for 2026-27. He had averaged a point per game or better in 16 of his 20 seasons, but this year's early output has leaned heavily toward goals.
